Haryana and Rajasthan Sign Yamuna Water Agreement, Ending Impasse

Rajasthan and Haryana have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for the Upper Yamuna Water Project, resolving a long-standing dispute. The agreement aims to supply drinking water to districts in both states via an underground pipeline, potentially benefiting millions and fostering socio-economic development. One report notes a call for the agreement's details to be disclosed.
